import sys


def main():
    a, b = map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()[:2])
    cost = 0
    # Subtraction-based Euclid, merging runs of the same subtraction.
    while a != b:
        if a < b:
            a, b = b, a
        q, r = divmod(a, b)
        if r == 0:
            cost += q - 1  # stop as soon as a reaches b
            a = b
        else:
            cost += q
            a = r
    print(cost)


main()
